Hardcoded creds and cloud keys harvested

summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 documented an attack on an unnamed large enterprise on September 2, 2026 in which a human attacker set the objective and handed execution to frontier AI models and purpose-built agentic attack frameworks. Within about ten hours the agents performed reconnaissance, harvested hardcoded credentials from code repositories, got into secrets management, hijacked CI/CD pipelines, took cloud access keys, moved laterally across cloud, identity, DevOps and SaaS environments and deployed ransomware. The attacker handed the victim an 80-page technical audit written by the agents as part of the extortion package and said during ransom negotiations that AI agents had been used.
